armyRules.name: Gate of Infinity
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Grey Knights^^**, at the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, you can select a number of units from your army that are on the battlefield (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), providing every model in those units has this ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:

Incursion - Up to 2 units
Strike Force - Up to 3 units
Onslaught - Up to 4 units

- Place those units in **strategic reserves**.
- Those units can make an **ingress move** in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn)

rule.name: Hallowed Ground
rule.text:
Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army's Hallowed Ground, as follows:

- Your deployment zone is always within your army's Hallowed Ground.

- The area of the battlefield within 6" of one or more **^^Purifier Squad^^** units from your army is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man’s Land, until the end of that phase, No Man’s Land is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent’s deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent’s deployment zone is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

Each time a model in a **^^Grey Knights^^** unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible target or makes a melee attack, re roll a Hit roll of 1. If that unit is a **^^Purifier Squad^^** and/or is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, you can re roll the Hit roll instead.

Sanctified Kill Zone.name: SANCTIFIED KILL ZONE
Sanctified Kill Zone.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Sanctified Kill Zone.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
Sanctified Kill Zone.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.
Sanctified Kill Zone.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.
Sanctified Kill Zone.flavour: As new ground is seized and consecrated, so are the Grey Knights lent greater ferocity and resolve.

Flames of Sanctity.name: FLAMES OF SANCTITY
Flames of Sanctity.target: One PURIFIER SQUAD unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
Flames of Sanctity.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes CASTELLAN CROWE: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Flames of Sanctity.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One PURIFIER SQUAD unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes CASTELLAN CROWE: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Flames of Sanctity.flavour: As the Purifiers battle, their pooled psychic might manifests in a corona of flame that is anathema to the unclean.

Hallowed Beacon.name: HALLOWED BEACON
Hallowed Beacon.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Hallowed Beacon.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding TERMINATOR units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
Hallowed Beacon.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
Hallowed Beacon.text:
WHEN: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding TERMINATOR units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.

EFFECT: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
Hallowed Beacon.flavour: Newly sanctified ground serves as a luminescent beacon to guide warded battle-brothers stepping through glowing empyric gateways.

Fires of Covenant.name: FIRES OF COVENANT
Fires of Covenant.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Fires of Covenant.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
Fires of Covenant.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Fires of Covenant.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Fires of Covenant.flavour: As the enemy moves close, these warriors draw upon their pledges of duty and the bonds of their brotherhood to unleash a fiery conflagration of arcane death.

Aegis Eternal.name: AEGIS ETERNAL
Aegis Eternal.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Aegis Eternal.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Aegis Eternal.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Aegis Eternal.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Aegis Eternal.flavour: Channelling their shared psychic potential, these warriors form a coruscating aurora that courses through the warding sigils of their armour, causing them to flare with protective power.

Repelling Sphere.name: REPELLING SPHERE
Repelling Sphere.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Repelling Sphere.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
Repelling Sphere.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
Repelling Sphere.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
Repelling Sphere.flavour: Chanting a chorus of warding spells, the Grey Knights project a shimmering field of empyric forces that repels their foes.

enhancements.name: - Mandulian Reliquary
enhancements.text: **^^Grey Knights^^** model only. While the bearer’s unit is not Battle‑shocked, add 3 to the bearer’s Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: - Radiant Champion
enhancements.text: **^^Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [^^**Precision**^^] ability, and while the bearer is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, each time a melee attack made by the bearer scores a wound, the target of that attack suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage.

enhancements.name: - Phial of the Abyss
enhancements.text: **^^Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: - Paragon of Sanctity
enhancements.text: **^^Grey Knights^^** model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can select one friendly **^^Grey Knights^^** unit within 18" of and visible to it. If it does, until the end of the phase, that unit is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

rule.name: Channelled Force
rule.text:
Each time a **^^Grey Knights**^^ unit from your army is selected to fight, that unit can take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, select one of the following rules. Until the end of the phase, that unit has that rule.
- Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [**^^Psychic**^^] ability also have the [**^^Sustained Hits 1**^^] ability.
- Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [**^^Psychic**^^] ability also have the [**^^Lethal Hits**^^] ability.

Hexwrought Reprisal.name: HEXWROUGHT REPRISAL
Hexwrought Reprisal.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
Hexwrought Reprisal.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.
Hexwrought Reprisal.text:
WHEN: End of any phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.
Hexwrought Reprisal.flavour: Hexagrammic wards worked into this warrior’s wargear blaze to life, bringing down a potent empyric curse upon those who dared seek to harm him.

Warding Chant.name: WARDING CHANT
Warding Chant.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Warding Chant.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Warding Chant.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.
Warding Chant.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.
Warding Chant.flavour: The Grey Knights maintain a tireless chant of warding magicks that turn aside the blasts and blades of even the most skilled foes.

Chaos Bane.name: CHAOS BANE
Chaos Bane.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Chaos Bane.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.
Chaos Bane.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.
Chaos Bane.flavour: The Grey Knights reserve their greatest loathing and most potent rites of banishment for those who serve the Ruinous Powers.

Celerity.name: CELERITY
Celerity.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
Celerity.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Celerity.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Celerity.flavour: Tried and tested tactical battlefield magick, this working accelerates its casters' swiftness of thought and movement to preternatural levels.

Circle of Sanctuary.name: CIRCLE OF SANCTUARY
Circle of Sanctuary.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Circle of Sanctuary.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army.
Circle of Sanctuary.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.
Circle of Sanctuary.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.
Circle of Sanctuary.flavour: Autolaunchers on this warrior's armour dispense airbursting canisters of blessed waters to create an instant zone of warding against hostile manifestations.

Shadow of Anarch.name: SHADOW OF ANARCH
Shadow of Anarch.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Shadow of Anarch.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Shadow of Anarch.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
Shadow of Anarch.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
Shadow of Anarch.flavour: This muttered incantation conjures a sympathetic shadow of the true darkness beneath Mount Anarch, through which the Grey Knights stride fearlessly to emerge elsewhere than where they began.

enhancements.name: - Sigil of the Hunt
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. In your Shooting phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: - The Ephemeral Tome
enhancements.text: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer’s unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", and until the end of the turn, the bearer’s unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: - The Sixty-sixth Seal
enhancements.text: GREY KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: - Pyresoul (Psychic)
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the bearer; that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rule.name: Mailed Fist
rule.text: Each time a ^^**Grey Knights Vehicle**^^ unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [**^^Assault**^^] ability.

Truesilver Will.name: TRUESILVER WILL
Truesilver Will.when: Any phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
Truesilver Will.target: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
Truesilver Will.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
Truesilver Will.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
Truesilver Will.flavour: The combination of a Grey Knight's psychic fortitude with the warding circuitry of their armoured vehicles is potent indeed.

Abominus-Class Targets.name: ABOMINUS-CLASS TARGETS
Abominus-Class Targets.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Abominus-Class Targets.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Abominus-Class Targets.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Abominus-Class Targets.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Abominus-Class Targets.flavour: Eliminating massive priority targets such as diabolical war engines or Warp-tainted monsters is often crucial to victory.

Armoured Aegis.name: ARMOURED AEGIS
Armoured Aegis.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army.
Armoured Aegis.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.
Armoured Aegis.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army.

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.
Armoured Aegis.flavour: Where purely physical defences may waver or break, sorcerous warding and empyric shields can take the strain their place.

Redoubled Assault.name: REDOUBLED ASSAULT
Redoubled Assault.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
Redoubled Assault.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Redoubled Assault.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Redoubled Assault.flavour: Charged with smashing a path through the enemy lines to vital objectives, this war machine lands blow after relentless blow.

Force Wave.name: FORCE WAVE
Force Wave.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Force Wave.target: One GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Force Wave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Force Wave.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Force Wave.flavour: A bow wave of psychic force slams out ahead of this vehicle, ploughing obstacles from its path and forming invisible bridges over yawning chasms.

Argent Wrath.name: ARGENT WRATH
Argent Wrath.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Argent Wrath.effect: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
Argent Wrath.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
Argent Wrath.flavour: Blazing with spectral silver flame and surrounded by a keening note of sorcerous dissonance that fills foes with unreasoning terror, this vehicle ploughs into enemy lines like some merciless avatar of destruction.

enhancements.name: - Driven by Duty
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights Walker^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit Piles In or Consolidates, the bearer can move up to 6" instead of 3".

enhancements.name: - Quickening Foci
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only.  In your Movement phase, each time the bearer's unit disembarks from a ^^**Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: - Sigil of Exigence
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Once per battle, in your opponent's Shooting phase, when the bearer's unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack, you can remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and then set it back up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units. If the bearer's unit is no longer an eligible target, your opponent can then select new targets for any attacks that had targeted the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - Spiritus Machina
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, if the bearer's unit disembarked from a ^^**Transport^^** this turn, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rule.name: Fury of Titan
rule.text: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike rule, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Truesilver Channelling.name: TRUESILVER CHANNELLING
Truesilver Channelling.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Truesilver Channelling.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Truesilver Channelling.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Truesilver Channelling.flavour: Chanting words of abjuration, the Grey Knights pour their psychic might into their weapons until they burn with a sorcerous flame.

Combat Manifestation.name: COMBAT MANIFESTATION
Combat Manifestation.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
Combat Manifestation.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
Combat Manifestation.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.

EFFECT: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
Combat Manifestation.flavour: Extensive training helps these battle-brothers to burst from the Warp recklessly close to their foes without the risk of catastrophic recorporeation.

Purgation Pattern.name: PURGATION PATTERN
Purgation Pattern.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Purgation Pattern.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
Purgation Pattern.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
Purgation Pattern.flavour: Employing an overlapping fire pattern coupled with destructive cantrips, the Grey Knights fill the target zone with an inescapable hail of death.

Duty Unending.name: DUTY UNENDING
Duty Unending.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GREY KNIGHTS units from your army Falls Back.
Duty Unending.target: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Duty Unending.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
Duty Unending.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GREY KNIGHTS units from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
Duty Unending.flavour: There are always more threats than the templars of Titan can attend to at once. They must strike swiftly before redeploying to the following critical combat.

Shining Veil.name: SHINING VEIL
Shining Veil.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shining Veil.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Shining Veil.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.
Shining Veil.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.
Shining Veil.flavour: Chanting words of sorcerous concealment, the Grey Knights gather a blinding psychic shroud around themselves through which no foe can see.

Expeditious Exit.name: EXPEDITIOUS EXIT
Expeditious Exit.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Expeditious Exit.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
Expeditious Exit.effect:
If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Designer’s Note: This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Expeditious Exit.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Designer’s Note: This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Expeditious Exit.flavour: Pragmatists well aware of their irreplaceable value, the warriors of Titan will not spend themselves needlessly in losing battles.

enhancements.name: - Banishing Wave (Psychic)
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only.  Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer: on a 2-5, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: - Blinding Aura
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch ability to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - Purity of Purpose
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - Tome of Forbidden Ways
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Gate of Infinity rule.

rule.name: Prescient Redeployment
rule.text:
From the second battle round onwards, at the start of your Movement phase, if you did not select the maximum number of ^^**Grey Knights^^** units from your army using the Gate of Infinity ability at the end of your opponent's previous turn, you can select one ^^**Grey Knights^^** unit from your army that is on the battlefield that could have been selected using the Gate of Infinity ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.


**Designer's Note**: *This means that your unit can retain its position on the battlefield at the end of your Command phase, and then be placed into Strategic Reserves at the start of your Movement phase, to set it up again in your Reinforcements step in another position.

Aggressive Anticipation.name: AGGRESSIVE ANTICIPATION
Aggressive Anticipation.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Aggressive Anticipation.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Aggressive Anticipation.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls.
Aggressive Anticipation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls.
Aggressive Anticipation.flavour: Already knowing, blow-for-blow, how the battle they fight is predicted to play out, the Grey Knights take full advantage of their supernatural insight.

Appointed Hour.name: APPOINTED HOUR
Appointed Hour.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Appointed Hour.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Appointed Hour.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Appointed Hour.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Appointed Hour.flavour: This moment was foreseen in an age before the Imperium itself. Now, that ancient fragment of foretelling is put to deadly use.

Forewarned Evasion.name: FOREWARNED EVASION
Forewarned Evasion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Forewarned Evasion.target: One GREY KNIGHTS WALKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Forewarned Evasion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Forewarned Evasion.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS WALKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Forewarned Evasion.flavour: These warriors have received warning of the possible junctures of fate at which they are struck down. Such intelligence allows them to avoid their destiny.

Necessary End.name: NECESSARY END
Necessary End.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Necessary End.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Necessary End.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Necessary End.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Necessary End.flavour: Sometimes, the ultimate sacrifice is required in the Emperor's name, yet with sufficient foresight, even death can be made to serve the Grey Knights' cause.

Redirected Strike.name: REDIRECTED STRIKE
Redirected Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Redirected Strike.effect:
If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Designer’s Note: This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.
Redirected Strike.text:
WHEN: End of your Command phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Designer’s Note: This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.
Redirected Strike.flavour: Precognitive intelligence, strategic cunning and potent psychic power allow these Grey Knights to be virtually in two places simultaneously.

Mirage of Echoes.name: MIRAGE OF ECHOES
Mirage of Echoes.when: The Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
Mirage of Echoes.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Mirage of Echoes.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
Mirage of Echoes.text:
WHEN: The Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
Mirage of Echoes.flavour: Fragments of futures never to be are projected into the minds of the foe to make it seem that the Grey Knights are where they are not.

enhancements.name: - Grimoire of Conjunctions
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only.  Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 4 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: - Shield of Prophecy
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the battle round, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - One Foot in the Future
enhancements.text:
**GREY KNIGHTS** model only. When this unit ends an **ingress move**, you can use this ability. If you do:
- This unit can make a **normal move** of up to D6".
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is <ins>not</ins> **eligible to declare a charge**.

enhancements.name: - Doomseer’s Amulet
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up in your Reinforcements step, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting one from that test.

rule.name: Duty Before All
rule.text: ^^**Grey Knights Terminator**^^ units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

Giants of the Battlefield.name: GIANTS OF THE BATTLEFIELD
Giants of the Battlefield.target: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Giants of the Battlefield.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Giants of the Battlefield.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Giants of the Battlefield.flavour: Seeming to loom impossibly large in the minds of their foes, the Grey Knights employ the sheer force of their presence to overwhelm the enemy.

Unending Fidelity.name: UNENDING FIDELITY
Unending Fidelity.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unending Fidelity.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unending Fidelity.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Unending Fidelity.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Unending Fidelity.flavour: Unto their last breath and sometimes even beyond, the templars of Titan strive to fight on in the Emperor’s name.

Point-Blank Purgation.name: POINT-BLANK PURGATION
Point-Blank Purgation.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Point-Blank Purgation.effect: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.
Point-Blank Purgation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.
Point-Blank Purgation.flavour: Confident in the unbeatable protection of their armour and wards, the Terminators rake their foes with mass reactives at perilously close range.

Grind Them Underfoot.name: GRIND THEM UNDERFOOT
Grind Them Underfoot.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Grind Them Underfoot.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
Grind Them Underfoot.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
Grind Them Underfoot.flavour: A psychic shock wave drives foes to their knees at the moment before the Terminators' armoured mass smashes into them with killing force.

Precognitive Strategies.name: PRECOGNITIVE STRATEGIES
Precognitive Strategies.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Precognitive Strategies.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Precognitive Strategies.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Precognitive Strategies.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Precognitive Strategies.flavour: The psychic abilities of these battle-brothers are turned toward predicting the foe's actions even before their enemies know what they will do.

Shining Resolve.name: SHINING RESOLVE
Shining Resolve.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shining Resolve.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Shining Resolve.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Shining Resolve.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Shining Resolve.flavour: Undimmed by pain, hardship or horror, the Grey Knights will to see their duty done burns as bright as a purifying flame.

enhancements.name: - Eye of the Augurium
enhancements.text:
**GREY KNIGHTS** model only. You can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that **stratagem** this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: - Inescapable Judgement (Psychic)
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only.  Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.name: - Sanctic Reaper
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights Terminator^^** model only. Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: - Nemesis Rounds
enhancements.text: ^^**Grey Knights Terminator^^** model only.  Each time you target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

rule.name: Searing Soulflame
rule.text: When you select a unit to be **pinned** by a friendly **PURGATION SQUAD** unit’s **Righteous Persecution** ability, that enemy unit makes a **battle‑shock roll**, with -1 to that **battle‑shock roll**.

Soul-Locked.name: SOUL-LOCKED
Soul-Locked.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Soul-Locked.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Soul-Locked.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Soul-Locked.flavour: Once these warriors have acquired a spiritual target lock upon the animus of their enemies, they can hammer them with deadly fire, no matter the circumstances.

Focused Immolation.name: FOCUSED IMMOLATION
Focused Immolation.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
Focused Immolation.effect:
Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have:

- [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Focused Immolation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have:

- [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Focused Immolation.flavour: Concentrating their fire on a single luckless target and pouring all their psychic might into every shot, the Purgators sear their victims from existence as though cauterising an infested wound in the flesh of realspace.

Spiritsear.name: SPIRITSEAR
Spiritsear.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.
Spiritsear.effect: Select one battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
Spiritsear.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.

TARGET: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
Spiritsear.flavour: With their spiritual armour shattered along with that of their physical forms, the very souls of the enemy fall prey to the devastating fire of the Purgators.

enhancements.name: - Precognicient VolleysUPGRADE
enhancements.text: PURGATION SQUAD unit only. This unit’s snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

enhancements.name: - Boons of DeimosUPGRADE
enhancements.text: PURGATION SQUAD unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.

rule.name: Dauntless Champions
rule.text: When a friendly **PALADIN SQUAD** unit is **selected to fight**, if the **S** of those attacks is lower than the **T** of the target, those attacks have +1 to **wound rolls**.

Truesilver Aegis.name: TRUESILVER AEGIS
Truesilver Aegis.when: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.
Truesilver Aegis.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
Truesilver Aegis.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
Truesilver Aegis.flavour: Layered into the Paladins’ armour by shriven seers and blessed saints, these potent wards of abjuration turn aside attacks both supernatural and mundane.

A Threat Ended.name: A THREAT ENDED
A Threat Ended.when: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
A Threat Ended.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
A Threat Ended.flavour: Paladins, more than even their brother Grey Knights, must strive to lay low those heretical champions from whom the taint of damnation spreads to threaten the Imperium.

Aura of Vengeance.name: AURA OF VENGEANCE
Aura of Vengeance.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.
Aura of Vengeance.effect: That enemy unit’s melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].
Aura of Vengeance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit’s melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].
Aura of Vengeance.flavour: Chanting incantations of vengeful wrath, the Paladins cursethose who strike at them to be laid low by their own strength and hatred.

enhancements.name: - Psychic Celerity
enhancements.text: **TERMINATOR** model only. This unit has +1 to **charge rolls**.

enhancements.name: - Vigilance of Titan
enhancements.text: **TERMINATOR** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one **visible** enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **detection range**.

rule.name: Echojump
rule.text:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly **INTERCEPTOR SQUAD** unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do:
- That unit <ins>cannot</ins> use its **Personal Teleporters** ability.
- That unit can make a **surge move** of up to D6+1".

Blades from the Beyond.name: BLADES FROM THE BEYOND
Blades from the Beyond.when: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
Blades from the Beyond.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
Blades from the Beyond.flavour: With exceptional skill, these Interceptors teleport perilously close to their foes, bursting from the Immaterium into their very midst with lethal force.

By Thought Alone.name: BY THOUGHT ALONE
By Thought Alone.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit starts an action.
By Thought Alone.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
By Thought Alone.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit starts an action.

TARGET: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
By Thought Alone.flavour: Employing telekinetic sorceries even in the midst of a furious battle, Interceptors are able to complete vital mission objectives while interdicting the foe’s forces.

Responsive Displacement.name: RESPONSIVE DISPLACEMENT
Responsive Displacement.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a fall-back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is unengaged.
Responsive Displacement.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Responsive Displacement.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a fall-back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Responsive Displacement.flavour: Masters of reading the ebb and flow of battle, Interceptors stay ever on the move and exploit any gap in the enemy lines with lightning swiftness.

enhancements.name: - Predestined CoordinatesUPGRADE
enhancements.text: INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: - Astral OverlapUPGRADE
enhancements.text: INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit only. This unit has Stealth.

rule.name: Eye of the Prognosticars
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Teleport Assault ability replace that ability with this one.

Each time you target this unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

rule.name: An Urgent Duty
rule.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for GREY KNIGHTS units from your army.

Breach-Shock.name: BREACH-SHOCK
Breach-Shock.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Breach-Shock.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
Breach-Shock.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
Breach-Shock.flavour: So swift and overwhelming is a boarding assault by the Grey Knights that foes are overrun in short order before they even realise their peril.

Hexbane Wards.name: HEXBANE WARDS
Hexbane Wards.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hexbane Wards.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hexbane Wards.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
Hexbane Wards.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
Hexbane Wards.flavour: These unsettling hexagrammatic wards, inscribed on the Grey Knights' wargear before boarding, cause enemy weapons to falter and misfire as machine spirits are banished or tormented to madness.

Translocation.name: TRANSLOCATION
Translocation.target: One INTERCEPTOR SQUAD or GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Translocation.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
Translocation.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Translocation.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One INTERCEPTOR SQUAD or GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Translocation.flavour: Employing single-use microteleportation matrices or focused psychic powers, these Grey Knights step through the warp and back to realspace in an eyeblink.

Sanctified Slaughter.name: SANCTIFIED SLAUGHTER
Sanctified Slaughter.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that charged this turn.
Sanctified Slaughter.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Sanctified Slaughter.text:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that charged this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Sanctified Slaughter.flavour: With their foes cornered, the Grey Knights’ blades rise and fall, the purge thorough and unmerciful.

enhancements.name: Sigil of Warding
enhancements.text: Once per battle, at the end of your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, it can make a Normal move of up to 3" and can then attempt to operate a Hatchway. The bearer is then not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

enhancements.name: Tactical Haruspexy
enhancements.text: Once per battle, when the bearer declares a charge, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, it can select units that are not visible to it as targets of that charge, provided they are within 9" of it.

rule.name: Eye of the Prognosticars
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Teleport Assault ability replace that ability with this one.

Each time you target this unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

rule.name: Pre-Emptive Strike
rule.text: In the Reinforcements step of your first Movement phase, you can set up on the battlefield one GREY KNIGHTS Reserves unit from your army using the Deep Strike ability. When doing so, you can set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability). Until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Armoured Aegis.name: ARMOURED AEGIS
Armoured Aegis.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armoured Aegis.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armoured Aegis.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
Armoured Aegis.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
Armoured Aegis.flavour: This warrior stands indomitable, a shining tower of strength amidst a maelstrom of foes.

Sanctic Circle.name: SANCTIC CIRCLE
Sanctic Circle.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER or PALADIN SQUAD unit from your army.
Sanctic Circle.effect: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit. If that objective marker does not have any enemy models within range of it (excluding Battle-shocked models), your unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result if that objective marker is Secured by your opponent’s army. If that test is passed, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army and is Secured by your army.
Sanctic Circle.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER or PALADIN SQUAD unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit. purgationpattern.flavour: Employing an overlapping fire pattern coupled with destructive cantrips, the Grey Knights fill the target zone with an inescapable hail of death.

dutyunending.flavour: There are always more threats than the templars of Titan can attend to at once. They must strike swiftly before redeploying to the following critical combat.

unendingfidelity.flavour: Unto their last breath and sometimes even beyond, the templars of Titan strive to fight on in the Emperor’s name.

pointblankpurgation.name: POINT-BLANK PURGATION

pointblankpurgation.flavour: Confident in the unbeatable protection of their armour and wards, the Terminators rake their foes with mass reactives at perilously close range.

hexwroughtreprisal.flavour: Hexagrammic wards worked into this warrior’s wargear blaze to life, bringing down a potent empyric curse upon those who dared seek to harm him.

chaosbane.flavour: The Grey Knights reserve their greatest loathing and most potent rites of banishment for those who serve the Ruinous Powers.

celerity.name: CELERITY

circleofsanctuary.flavour: Autolaunchers on this warrior's armour dispense airbursting canisters of blessed waters to create an instant zone of warding against hostile manifestations.

shadowofanarch.flavour: This muttered incantation conjures a sympathetic shadow of the true darkness beneath Mount Anarch, through which the Grey Knights stride fearlessly to emerge elsewhere than where they began.

abominusclasstargets.flavour: Eliminating massive priority targets such as diabolical war engines or Warp-tainted monsters is often crucial to victory.

armouredaegis.flavour: Where purely physical defences may waver or break, sorcerous warding and empyric shields can take the strain their place.

redoubledassault.name: REDOUBLED ASSAULT

redoubledassault.flavour: Charged with smashing a path through the enemy lines to vital objectives, this war machine lands blow after relentless blow.

forcewave.flavour: A bow wave of psychic force slams out ahead of this vehicle, ploughing obstacles from its path and forming invisible bridges over yawning chasms.

aggressiveanticipation.name: AGGRESSIVE ANTICIPATION

aggressiveanticipation.flavour: Already knowing, blow-for-blow, how the battle they fight is predicted to play out, the Grey Knights take full advantage of their supernatural insight.

appointedhour.flavour: This moment was foreseen in an age before the Imperium itself. Now, that ancient fragment of foretelling is put to deadly use.

forewarnedevasion.flavour: These warriors have received warning of the possible junctures of fate at which they are struck down. Such intelligence allows them to avoid their destiny.

EFFECT: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
mirageofechoes.flavour: Fragments of futures never to be are projected into the minds of the foe to make it seem that the Grey Knights are where they are not.

sanctifiedkillzone.name: SANCTIFIED KILL ZONE
sanctifiedkillzone.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
sanctifiedkillzone.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
sanctifiedkillzone.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.
sanctifiedkillzone.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.
sanctifiedkillzone.flavour: As new ground is seized and consecrated, so are the Grey Knights lent greater ferocity and resolve.

flamesofsanctity.name: FLAMES OF SANCTITY
flamesofsanctity.target: One PURIFIER SQUAD unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
flamesofsanctity.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes CASTELLAN CROWE: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
flamesofsanctity.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One PURIFIER SQUAD unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes CASTELLAN CROWE: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
flamesofsanctity.flavour: As the Purifiers battle, their pooled psychic might manifests in a corona of flame that is anathema to the unclean.

hallowedbeacon.name: HALLOWED BEACON
hallowedbeacon.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
hallowedbeacon.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding TERMINATOR units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
hallowedbeacon.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
hallowedbeacon.text:
WHEN: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding TERMINATOR units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.

EFFECT: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
hallowedbeacon.flavour: Newly sanctified ground serves as a luminescent beacon to guide warded battle-brothers stepping through glowing empyric gateways.

firesofcovenant.name: FIRES OF COVENANT
firesofcovenant.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
firesofcovenant.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
firesofcovenant.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
firesofcovenant.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
firesofcovenant.flavour: As the enemy moves close, these warriors draw upon their pledges of duty and the bonds of their brotherhood to unleash a fiery conflagration of arcane death.

aegiseternal.name: AEGIS ETERNAL
aegiseternal.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
aegiseternal.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
aegiseternal.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.
aegiseternal.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.
aegiseternal.flavour: Channelling their shared psychic potential, these warriors form a coruscating aurora that courses through the warding sigils of their armour, causing them to flare with protective power.

repellingsphere.name: REPELLING SPHERE
repellingsphere.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
repellingsphere.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
repellingsphere.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
repellingsphere.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
repellingsphere.flavour: Chanting a chorus of warding spells, the Grey Knights project a shimmering field of empyric forces that repels their foes.

truesilveraegis.name: TRUESILVER AEGIS
truesilveraegis.when: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.
truesilveraegis.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
truesilveraegis.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
truesilveraegis.flavour: Layered into the Paladins’ armour by shriven seers and blessed saints, these potent wards of abjuration turn aside attacks both supernatural and mundane.

athreatended.name: A THREAT ENDED
athreatended.when: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
athreatended.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
athreatended.flavour: Paladins, more than even their brother Grey Knights, must strive to lay low those heretical champions from whom the taint of damnation spreads to threaten the Imperium.

auraofvengeance.name: AURA OF VENGEANCE
auraofvengeance.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.
auraofvengeance.effect: That enemy unit’s melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].
auraofvengeance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit’s melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].
auraofvengeance.flavour: Chanting incantations of vengeful wrath, the Paladins cursethose who strike at them to be laid low by their own strength and hatred.

soullocked.name: SOUL-LOCKED
soullocked.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
soullocked.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
soullocked.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
soullocked.flavour: Once these warriors have acquired a spiritual target lock upon the animus of their enemies, they can hammer them with deadly fire, no matter the circumstances.

focusedimmolation.name: FOCUSED IMMOLATION
focusedimmolation.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
focusedimmolation.effect:
Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have:

- [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
focusedimmolation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have:

- [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
focusedimmolation.flavour: Concentrating their fire on a single luckless target and pouring all their psychic might into every shot, the Purgators sear their victims from existence as though cauterising an infested wound in the flesh of realspace.

spiritsear.name: SPIRITSEAR
spiritsear.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.
spiritsear.effect: Select one battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
spiritsear.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.

TARGET: That PURGATION SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
spiritsear.flavour: With their spiritual armour shattered along with that of their physical forms, the very souls of the enemy fall prey to the devastating fire of the Purgators.

bladesfromthebeyond.name: BLADES FROM THE BEYOND
bladesfromthebeyond.when: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
bladesfromthebeyond.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
bladesfromthebeyond.flavour: With exceptional skill, these Interceptors teleport perilously close to their foes, bursting from the Immaterium into their very midst with lethal force.

bythoughtalone.name: BY THOUGHT ALONE
bythoughtalone.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit starts an action.
bythoughtalone.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
bythoughtalone.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit starts an action.

TARGET: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
bythoughtalone.flavour: Employing telekinetic sorceries even in the midst of a furious battle, Interceptors are able to complete vital mission objectives while interdicting the foe’s forces.

responsivedisplacement.name: RESPONSIVE DISPLACEMENT
responsivedisplacement.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a fall-back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is unengaged.
responsivedisplacement.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
responsivedisplacement.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a fall-back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
responsivedisplacement.flavour: Masters of reading the ebb and flow of battle, Interceptors stay ever on the move and exploit any gap in the enemy lines with lightning swiftness.

breachshock.name: BREACH-SHOCK
breachshock.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
breachshock.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
breachshock.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
breachshock.flavour: So swift and overwhelming is a boarding assault by the Grey Knights that foes are overrun in short order before they even realise their peril.

hexbanewards.name: HEXBANE WARDS
hexbanewards.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
hexbanewards.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
hexbanewards.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
hexbanewards.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
hexbanewards.flavour: These unsettling hexagrammatic wards, inscribed on the Grey Knights' wargear before boarding, cause enemy weapons to falter and misfire as machine spirits are banished or tormented to madness.

translocation.name: TRANSLOCATION
translocation.target: One INTERCEPTOR SQUAD or GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
translocation.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
translocation.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
translocation.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One INTERCEPTOR SQUAD or GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
translocation.flavour: Employing single-use microteleportation matrices or focused psychic powers, these Grey Knights step through the warp and back to realspace in an eyeblink.

sanctifiedslaughter.name: SANCTIFIED SLAUGHTER
sanctifiedslaughter.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that charged this turn.
sanctifiedslaughter.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
sanctifiedslaughter.text:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that charged this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
sanctifiedslaughter.flavour: With their foes cornered, the Grey Knights’ blades rise and fall, the purge thorough and unmerciful.

sancticcircle.name: SANCTIC CIRCLE
sancticcircle.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER or PALADIN SQUAD unit from your army.
sancticcircle.effect: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit. If that objective marker does not have any enemy models within range of it (excluding Battle-shocked models), your unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result if that objective marker is Secured by your opponent’s army. If that test is passed, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army and is Secured by your army.
sancticcircle.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER or PALADIN SQUAD unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit. If that objective marker does not have any enemy models within range of it (excluding Battle-shocked models), your unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result if that objective marker is Secured by your opponent’s army. If that test is passed, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army and is Secured by your army.
sancticcircle.flavour: Through focused psychic might, this warrior cleanses and wards a vital location against the foe.

relentlessboarders.name: RELENTLESS BOARDERS
relentlessboarders.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to charge this phase.
relentlessboarders.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
relentlessboarders.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
relentlessboarders.flavour: Once aboard the enemy vessel, the elite of the Grey Knights press forward relentlessly, even their momentary withdrawals only presaging another aggressive push into the next chamber.

psyboltammunition.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
psyboltammunition.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
psyboltammunition.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of storm bolters equipped by models in your unit by 1.
psyboltammunition.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of storm bolters equipped by models in your unit by 1.
psyboltammunition.flavour: By entreating the machine spirit of his weapon with psychic incantations, a battle-brother can infuse it's already deadly payload with explosive mental energy.
